💧 What Is Liquidity?

This visual shows one of the most important concepts in trading: liquidity zones.

Liquidity forms in areas where many traders place their stop losses, usually above equal highs or below equal lows. These zones become targets for the market because that’s where large orders are sitting. 📍

In the image, the highlighted areas show where liquidity is resting. Price often moves into these zones to “collect” stops before shifting direction. 

This is why understanding liquidity helps traders avoid getting taken out too early and instead position themselves on the right side of the move. 🔥📈

A simple concept, but once you see it, you’ll never look at the chart the same way again. 📱 @nursejannah

Actress Tests Positive for Three Drugs, Arrested in VIP Room

A 40-year-old actress known for starring in a popular police drama was arrested after allegedly testing positive for amphetamine, methamphetamine, and ketamine during a raid on an unlicensed entertainment outlet in Kuala Lumpur.

The actress, who previously appeared in a singing reality show, was detained with several others inside a VIP room during the 3:15am operation conducted by Kuala Lumpur police and Dang Wangi police.

A total of 14 people were detained, including the outlet’s caretaker. Police also found the premises operating without a valid licence and selling liquor without permission.

Dang Wangi police chief Assistant Commissioner Sazali Adam confirmed the arrest.

Timbalan Menteri Kewangan, Liew Chin Tong berkata, daripada jumlah itu, kerajaan telah membayar RM42.5 bilion bagi melunaskan hutang dan komitmen 1MDB yang merangkumi bayaran prinsipal, faedah, kos guaman, kos operasi serta komitmen lain.

Menurut beliau, kerajaan masih perlu menanggung Nota Jangka Sederhana Islam (Sukuk Islamic Medium Term Notes) yang dijamin kerajaan berjumlah RM8.9 bilion, melibatkan bayaran prinsipal sebanyak RM5 bilion dan faedah RM3.9 bilion yang akan matang pada 2039.

"Secara keseluruhan, tanggungan 1MDB yang telah dan masih perlu ditanggung kerajaan adalah sebanyak RM51.4 bilion," katanya pada sesi soal jawab di Dewan Rakyat, hari ini (Khamis).
